summary: Q1 revise-propose resolved Q1-RP-003 by replacing perpetual historical canonical-path validation with a generation-aware validation boundary for mutable Change artifacts. A valid matching changes-requested -> revise-* lineage creates a bounded revision window and, after terminal successor publication, marks overwritten predecessor mutable refs as superseded. The current effective artifact set is reconstructed by lineage overlay and remains strictly content-hash validated before review, at revise completion, and after archive. Subset revisions inherit unchanged refs and fail terminal preflight if an undeclared artifact changed. The same root-cause rule covers verification.md across revise-apply/re-verification. Terminal Runs and exact review Run-result bindings remain immutable; no per-Run artifact snapshot/history store is introduced.

resolvedFindings.evidence: Proposal/design/persistence delta/bootstrap delta/tasks now define a complete propose -> review changes-requested -> revise subset -> review -> archive lifecycle. Reader first builds review/revise lineage, classifies mutable generations as current/revision-window/superseded, constructs the current effective artifact set by overlay, and strictly validates only current/inherited effective refs against canonical or archived bytes. Historical overwritten refs are exempt only when a valid successor lineage proves legitimate supersession; unauthorized overwrite still fails closed. Required tests explicitly cover P0 propose, R0 changes-requested, P1 subset revise, pre-archive reading of both terminal Runs, archive, post-archive final validation, undeclared subset mutation, and no-lineage overwrite.

preflight.fullReading: Read Q1-RP-003 requiredResolution and all referenced 118 Proposal sections. The finding permits either immutable per-generation targets or an explicit consistent historical validation boundary.

preflight.implementability: Checked current persistence/Reader contracts: ContextFile already carries sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict for revise lineage; ReviewVerdictFact carries reviewedRunId; current Reader reads schemaVersion 2 contexts/results and can be refactored to build lineage before mutable-ref validation; buildRunResultRef remains immutable Run-result binding. The design requires no self-reference, no new Policy state, and no artifact snapshot registry.
